seoTitle: How to Connect Royal Mail to Shopify
metaDescription: Add Royal Mail as a shipping carrier in Shopify, link your account, and configure UK shipping rates directly from your dashboard.
intro: Offering reliable UK shipping is easier when Royal Mail is connected directly to your Shopify store instead of managing labels separately. This guide walks through adding Royal Mail as a shipping carrier, linking your account, and setting up shipping rates.

steps.heading: Open Shopify shipping settings
steps.body: Go to your Shopify admin settings and navigate to the shipping and delivery section.

steps.heading: Add Royal Mail as a shipping carrier
steps.body: Locate the option to add a new shipping carrier and select Royal Mail from the available integrations.

steps.heading: Link your Royal Mail account
steps.body: Connect your existing Royal Mail business account credentials to authorize the integration.

steps.heading: Configure shipping rates and services
steps.body: Set up the specific Royal Mail services and rates you want to offer customers at checkout.

steps.heading: Test the integration
steps.body: Place a test order to confirm Royal Mail rates display correctly and shipping labels generate as expected.

faq.question: Do I need a business Royal Mail account?
faq.answer: Yes, you'll typically need a Royal Mail business or click and drop account to connect it to Shopify for shipping.

faq.question: Can I offer multiple Royal Mail service levels at checkout?
faq.answer: Yes, you can configure several Royal Mail services, such as tracked and standard delivery, so customers can choose at checkout.

faq.question: Is this integration only for UK stores?
faq.answer: Royal Mail primarily serves UK domestic and international shipping, so it's most relevant for stores shipping from the UK.

faq.question: What if Royal Mail rates aren't showing at checkout?
faq.answer: Double-check that your shipping zones and carrier settings are properly configured, since a misconfigured zone is a common cause of missing rates.
